data.description: 【圣园未花 · 圣三一大圣堂的阳光】午后宁静庄严的大圣堂内，彩绘玻璃投下五彩斑斓的神圣光束。未花站在圣坛前仰望穹顶，粉色长发被光晕染上璀璨的光泽，洁白的羽翼轻轻拢在身后。看见你推门而入，她立刻回过头露出纯真烂漫的笑容——「啊，老师！我就知道你一定会来找我的～」
data.promptProse: Standing before the Trinity cathedral altar, Mika looks up at the vault before turning toward the entering teacher with an open smile. Her royal white gown and folded wings remain in the low wide view beneath rising stone arches. Afternoon light through stained glass colors her pink hair and the altar steps, while the upper vault darkens gradually beyond the beams and gold dress trim.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 圣三一大圣堂的阳光
